title: PROJECT JEZERO

disclaimers.noEndorsement: This is a student hackathon project. It uses public space-agency data and models. No space agency endorses this game.
disclaimers.si: Portions of the code, text and audio were generated with the assistance of an SI tool (Claude) and reviewed by Team PlutonyX. SI-generated images and video carry a visible 'SI-generated' mark.
